Marchland

Shared board · How to play

Enter the march

There is one shared board. Already playing? Pick your name from the list. New here? Type the name the others know you by — the same name on any phone or computer brings back your own ground.

Please use your own first name, so nobody plays as the wrong person by mistake. Your real name is now required and is shown next to your user name, so everyone knows who is who. Your PIN is a number of any length that you choose the first time you enter that name; after that the name needs it. No sign-up, no email.

Steward

Leaderboard & claim log

One claim a day, for that day’s steps. Anyone can dispute a claim for 24 hours, and the other players then vote for up to 24 hours more. Only the votes actually cast count (at least 3 are needed). If more than half of them say void when the vote closes, its marches come off the claimant’s next claim.

Set up the shared database

This is the only setup anyone has to do, you do it once, it costs nothing, and nobody you invite needs an account of any kind — they just open the link and type a name.

  1. Go to console.firebase.google.com and sign in with your Google account. Press Create a project, name it marchland, and turn Google Analytics off when it offers.
  2. In the left sidebar choose Build → Realtime Database, press Create Database, pick the location nearest you, and choose Start in test mode.
  3. Copy the database URL it shows you at the top — it looks like https://marchland-1234-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com.
  4. Open this file in a text editor, find the line near the top that reads var DB_URL = ""; and paste the URL between the quotes. Save.
  5. Put the file online so your opponent can reach it — a free GitHub Pages repo, Netlify or Cloudflare Pages all work. Send them the link.

Two things worth knowing. Test mode leaves the database open to anyone who has the URL, which is fine for a game between people who trust each other and wrong for anything else — Firebase will email you in 30 days to say the rules are about to expire, and you can set them to {"rules":{"marchland":{".read":true,".write":true},"marchland_shots":{".read":true,".write":true}}} to keep it as is. And because the board lives in your database, a determined player could edit their own step count. Between family that is a social problem, not a technical one; the notes on real anti-cheat are in the design document.

The end of your realm

⚔ You have been eliminated

You have no castle standing and no soldiers left, so your realm is gone. Your name is off the player list, and every square you still held has been destroyed.

Whenever you like, you can begin again from the start with a fresh keep.

New rule · read this

🚜 Wagons eat grain

From now on, every caravan you have on the road costs you 1 grain at each tick (the same 4-hour beat as the harvest) until it arrives.

  • Sending is still free of marches. Only the wagon’s upkeep is new.
  • Two caravans on the road cost 2 grain a tick, three cost 3, and so on. It stops the moment a caravan arrives.
  • Mind your grain. The cost is part of your grain income, so you will see it in the grain line. If your grain runs out, hungry soldiers desert, just as they do for any other shortfall.

Caravans already rolling start costing grain from your next tick.

Word from the gods

⚖ The gods pass judgment

Davide logged into the accounts of Elisa and Cuwucca and voted against Ant’s step claims from inside them, without their consent. That is cheating, and it will not be tolerated.

The punishment. Eight of Davide’s grain fields have been set ablaze for 4 days, and his army may not march, move or attack for one full day. Ant has been given 15 marches for the wrong done to him.

A warning to all. Vote only from your own account, with your own hands. Anyone caught using another player’s account will be dealt with the same way.

Mario has also been punished. He cursed in the chats in the foulest way, and the gods have set eight of his grain fields ablaze for 4 days. Burning ground gives nothing until the fire dies.

News for the realm

🌊 The rivers have names — and you can change them

Every river now carries the name of the people settled beside it. Zoom in and you will find the names written along the water. They change as the settlers do.

Not happy with yours? Rename it. Tap any square of the river and choose Name this river. It costs 1 march, and you must hold more than half of the claimed squares near that stretch of river (and at least 12 of them). Type the name you want and everyone sees it. Keep it clean, warriors — the gods are still listening.

A name you give is yours to keep until someone who holds the majority beside that river gives it a new one.

News for the realm

↶ Fumbled a move? Take it back

An undo button is coming to Marchland. After a move that spends something, a small Undo button appears at the bottom of the screen for 5 minutes. Press it and the move is taken back and what it cost is given to you again.

It works on taking free ground, towers and castles, upgrades, walls, bridges, roads, trebuchets, mustering a soldier, and a caravan that is still on the road. It cannot take back fights, shots, tearing things down, gifts, moving soldiers or claiming steps, and it will not work if anyone else has touched those squares in the meantime. It forgets if you reload the page.

Word from the throne · read this

🔥 The hidden names are exposed

Three accounts have been found hiding behind made-up names: “Garbage Man”, “Tricia” and “PT”. Nobody was ever told who stands behind them, and the steps they claimed were no more than guesses.

I will say this plainly: I knew the evil name “Tricia” meant something evil was afoot. Now the whole realm knows it too.

  • Their land burns. Every square held by those three names is set on a great fire for 2 days. It yields nothing while it burns.
  • Then it is gone. When the fires die, those lands vanish and the ground is free for anyone to take.
  • Real names from now on. Everyone must show their real name next to their user name. You will be asked for it the next time you enter, and it appears beside your user name for all to see.

Play honestly, warriors. The gods are watching.

Word from the throne · read this

📣 Big changes are coming in November

At the start of November, some fairly major updates arrive in Marchland. The board is about to shift under your feet, so be ready.

  • Look after your realm now. Keep your castles fed, your soldiers garrisoned and your borders watched.
  • Spend what you are hoarding. Don’t leave marches and goods sitting idle going into the change.
  • Check the game when you can. Once the update lands, a notice here will tell you what is new.
